verdict.rationale: Published board power, connector requirements, and cooling guidance are fair questions for any GPU, so the axis applies. The evidence gives no per-card TDP or TGP figure, no connector specification, and no cooling guidance. It only says max power per GPU is reported at runtime by nvidia-smi and describes system-level PSUs with 5+1 redundancy in the DGX B200, which does not let anyone spec a build around this card.
